verdict.rationale: Whether a payments or stablecoin product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Stripe Crypto & Stablecoins' source being available under any open license. The pack covers only hosted APIs, docs, the MCP server and the CLI, none of which establishes open-source availability of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
